_comment: User-facing error, success, and validation messages. Keys are used by both frontend t() calls and for mapping BFF error strings.

success.notificationMarkedRead: Notification has been marked as read
success.notificationMarkedUnread: Notification has been marked as unread.
success.groupPlanSaved: Group Plan has been saved successfully

error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.copilotConnect: Could not connect to the assistant. Please try again later.
error.copilotMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.planSettingsFailed: Saving Plan Settings has been Failed!
error.groupPlanSaveFailed: Saving Group Plan has been Failed!

validation.marginFormat: Margin value must be in the format x.0 or x.5
validation.budgetLessThanSpent: Budget can't be less than spent
validation.budgetExceedsTotal: Total allocated budget cannot exceed total budget.

permission.readOnlyNotAllowed: Read-only users are not allowed to perform this action. Please contact an administrator if you need access.
permission.noPermissionsInContext: No permissions available. Please contact an administrator.
permission.alertNotOwned: You do not own this alert
permission.advertiserNotFollowed: You do not follow this advertiser
